requests.conflicts: Not submitting because conflicts remain ({count}). Choose with take in value and submit again: {shown}
requests.descriptionTooLong: The description must be at most 4000 characters
requests.line.approved: Approved MR {number} "{title}" and merged it (submitted by: {author})
requests.nothingToMerge: branch {name} has nothing to go into main
requests.numberNeeded: {op} needs number (the number of the MR)
requests.numberOf: target is the number of an MR (for example 3)
requests.opened: main is locked, so MR {number} was submitted instead of merging. When a person approves it in the app, it goes into main as the result below shows. Tell the user to look at MR {number} in the app ("MR" under main in the navigator) and approve it
requests.overlaps: Not submitting because the same path holds different things (rename or delete one of them, then submit): {shown}
requests.placesLeft: Sending branch_merge again with places: true also takes the positions moved on the branch
requests.reasonTooLong: The reason for rejection must be at most 120 characters
requests.resultOnlyMain: Only a merge into main can be opened to look at its result
requests.sourceMissing: There is no branch to merge from
requests.stale: MR {number} is out of date (the branch moved, or a change in main changed what goes in). Have the AI try it again and submit it again
requests.titleTooLong: The title must be at most 120 characters
requests.withdrawOther: MR {number} was submitted by {author}; only the access key that submitted it can withdraw it
